title: channels/1: the channels of a file, `mzlab-cli file channels` and `api/canali`
description: What an agent reads first about a file: TIC, BPC, one channel per scan type or precursor, one per SRM transition, UV and detector traces. All times are in minutes. Code: crates/mzlab-core/src/channels/output.rs.

kind.description: The experiment type the engine proposes (a proposal: the user's value wins).

reason.description: Why the type was proposed, a stable code (for example ms1_only, few_precursors, srm_only).

id.description: Channel id, the value of `--channel` and of `channel=` in the routes.

family.description: tic, bpc, ms, dd, srm, sim, uv or an.

generator.description: Index in `channels` of the channel it comes from (null: none).

ms_level.description: MS level, 0 when the channel has none (TIC, BPC, UV).

polarity.description: 1 positive, -1 negative, 0 unknown or not applicable.

code.description: Scan mode code (EMS, EPI, MRM, TWC, ...).

group.description: Key that puts the same channel of several files together (same scan type, precursor and polarity).

n_points.description: Number of scans or points of the trace.

rt_start_min.description: First retention time, minutes (0 when the channel is empty).

rt_end_min.description: Last retention time, minutes (0 when the channel is empty).

has_spectra.description: True when the channel has mass spectra to open.
